attributes.action: Make it legal for local councils to shut down vape shops for more than 3 months!
attributes.additional_details: Vape shops in the UK that get shut down only get shut down for threw months and then re open with just a new name we should have power to shut them down for good permanently
attributes.background: Our local councils should have the power to permanently shut down illegal vape shops or a longer period off time than just three months

departments.name: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

rejection.details: On 11 August, the Government announced that the maximum length of Closure Orders will double from six to 12 months. You can find out more here: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/pm-vows-to-save-hollowed-out-high-streets-with-crackdown-on-vape-and-betting-shops
